answer: One server does both jobs, so it is single, multi-purpose infrastructure, not separate dedicated hosts.
why: Same IP for C2 (port 80) and exfil (port 8081) means the attacker runs one box for multiple roles rather than segmented infrastructure. That points to a small or hastily-built operation, and it hands defenders a single chokepoint: block 185.92.220.87 and both command-and-control and exfiltration die, while the shared IP ties the whole intrusion to one actor (MITRE T1583).
